items.name: countdown-timer

items.name: toggle-pro

items.name: badges-kit

items.name: rating-stars

items.name: glare-card

items.name: infinite-marquee

items.name: discord-chat-widget

items.name: telegram-widget

items.name: messenger-widget

items.name: x-twitter-widget

items.name: footer-section

items.name: compare-slider
items.title: Compare Slider
items.description: A theme-aware before/after image comparison slider with horizontal or vertical drag direction, keyboard support, and before/after labels.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: Glow Card

items.name: image-showcase

items.name: eternal-glow-card

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack

items.name: glass-navigation

items.description: A glassmorphic pill navbar that expands into a full panel of large nav links, a tagline, and social links — with a CTA button, badges, active-page highlight, and auto/light/dark theming.

items.name: header-simple
items.title: Header Simple

items.name: hover-scan-card
items.title: Hover Scan Card

items.name: testimonial-spotlight
items.title: Testimonial Spotlight

items.name: testimonial-pills
items.title: Testimonial Pills

items.name: testimonial-video-wall
items.title: Testimonial Video Wall
items.description: A masonry wall mixing text and video testimonial cards, with a full custom video player (play/pause, seek, mute, replay, loading state) supporting native, YouTube and Vimeo sources.

items.name: profile-flip-card
items.title: Profile Flip Card
items.description: A profile card that flips from a photo front to a bio back on click or hover, with flip Y, flip X, spring, or fade transitions.

items.name: phone-mockup

items.name: laptop-mockup
items.title: Laptop Mockup
items.description: A realistic MacBook Pro frame (silver or space black) that auto-fits its container, with 3D cursor tilt, ambient glow, and a video/image player with slide or fade transitions.

items.name: browser-mockup
items.title: Browser Mockup
items.description: A realistic browser chrome frame in macOS, Windows, or mobile Safari style, with tabs, a URL bar, and a content area for an image, video, or arbitrary React children.

items.name: instagram-post-mockup
items.title: Instagram Post Mockup
items.description: A realistic Instagram post — avatar ring, swipeable multi-photo carousel, double-tap-to-like heart burst, like/comment/repost/share/save actions, and light/dark theme.

items.name: x-post-mockup
items.title: X Post Mockup
items.description: A realistic X (Twitter) post with a verified badge, media image, and interactive like/retweet/bookmark actions with live counts, in light or dark theme.

items.name: tiktok-post-mockup
items.title: TikTok Post Mockup
items.description: A full-bleed 9:16 TikTok feed mockup with a Following/For You tab bar, a side action rail (like/comment/save/share), caption overlay, sound pill, and bottom navigation.

items.name: linkedin-post-mockup
items.title: LinkedIn Post Mockup
items.description: A realistic LinkedIn post with a headline, media image, a reaction summary, and interactive like/repost actions with live counts, in light or dark theme.

items.name: cylinder-gallery
items.title: Cylinder Gallery
items.description: A 3D image gallery arranged around an auto-rotating cylinder, with configurable rows/columns, tilt angle, rotation speed, and edge fade opacity.

items.name: gallery-flow
items.title: Gallery Flow
items.description: A gallery of scattered, gently drifting image cards with random rotation, cursor repel/attract mode, pause-on-hover, and a click-to-open lightbox.

items.name: progress-circle-bars
items.title: Progress Circle Bars

items.name: linear-progress-bars
items.title: Linear Progress Bars
items.description: A card of linear progress rows — plain ratio bars, file-upload rows with icons/subtitles/shimmer, milestone ticks, and an inline variant — with scroll-triggered fill animation.

items.name: noise-background
items.title: Noise Background
items.description: A canvas background with animated film-grain noise, soft color blob gradients, 7 built-in themes (or fully custom colors), drifting blob animation, and a vignette.

items.name: ai-agent-wave
items.title: AI Agent Wave
items.description: A Siri-style glowing multi-strand waveform line for voice/AI assistant UIs — cursor-reactive boost, idle/listening/speaking state levels, and optional floating avatar bubbles.

items.name: logo-grid
items.title: Logo Grid
items.description: A wrapping grid of client/partner logos with scroll-triggered stagger reveal, magnetic cursor-follow hover, grayscale-to-color reveal, and optional name tooltips.

items.name: dot-image-slider
items.title: Dot Image Slider
items.description: A before/after image reveal — a luminance-mapped halftone dot rendering on one side, the real photo on the other, dragged apart by a glowing lightsaber-style divider handle.

items.name: animated-loader
items.title: Animated Loader
items.description: A loading spinner kit with 4 variants — rotating lines, ring, dual counter-rotating ring, and bouncing dots — sharing a common color/size/speed API.

items.name: animated-checkbox
items.title: Animated Checkbox
items.description: An accessible checkbox with an animated draw-in checkmark, focus ring, and optional label, helper text, required marker, and info tooltip.

items.name: sales-ticket-popup
items.title: Sales Ticket Popup
items.description: A corner-anchored promo popup shaped like a torn event ticket, with 5 themes, a zigzag badge stub, immediate/delay/scroll triggers, auto-hide, and dismiss-memory.

items.name: expand-card-grid
items.title: Expand Card Grid
items.description: A 2x2 grid of image cards that expand to fill the frame on click, revealing title/description/CTA — with keyboard arrow navigation between cards and swipe-to-close on touch.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: A drag-and-drop task board with a hand-rolled pointer-based drag engine — velocity tilt, edge autoscroll, ghost drop-position indicator, priority badges, avatar stacks, and light/dark theming.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: An admin data table with sortable/filterable columns, global search, status tabs, row selection, badge/avatar/actions cell types, pagination, and light/dark/custom theming.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: A multi-series line/area chart — smooth Catmull-Rom curves, a highlighted zone band, a reference line, endpoint value badges, and a hover crosshair with per-series tooltips.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: A stacked bar chart — up to 5 series per bar, a reference line, a peak-value annotation, and a hover tooltip breaking down each bar's segments with a running total.

items.name: tearable-reveal
items.title: Tearable Reveal
items.description: A physically-simulated cloth intro reveal — drag to tear open a torn-paper layer covering an image, with breakable constraints, particle debris, frayed jagged/rounded edges, and optional surface text or logo. Includes Auto Tear and Reset controls.

items.name: rotating-gallery
items.title: Rotating Gallery
items.description: An ambient, continuously auto-rotating 3D carousel of image cards arranged in a circle, with a front-facing title label — no interaction required, driven purely by CSS 3D transforms.

items.name: range-area-chart
items.title: Range Area Chart
items.description: A min/max envelope chart with a nested core-range band, an actual-to-forecast line split, annotated risk zones, a reference line, and a live endpoint badge.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: A multi-series radar/spider chart with ring gridlines, per-series solid or dashed strokes, optional point markers, and a hover tooltip comparing every series at the highlighted axis.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie Chart
items.description: A donut-style pie chart with a live center total, click-to-toggle legend, percentage callouts around the ring, and a hover tooltip with ARR, account count, and average contract size.

items.name: alert-toast
items.title: Alert Toast
items.description: A polished toast/alert notification — 5 tones, stacked or inline layout, icons, primary/secondary actions, dismiss and auto-dismiss, light/dark theme, plus a showcase mode rendering every variant side by side.

items.name: dot-image-loader
items.title: Dot Image Loader
items.description: An auto-animating loading screen — a halftone dot rendering of your image is scanned into existence by a glowing lightsaber-style sweep, then oscillates in a loop while a 'Preparing...' label and spinner play below.

items.name: product-grid-section
items.title: Product Grid Section
items.description: A responsive product/portfolio grid section — heading, per-card image with hover zoom and reveal overlay, category/price meta row, optional badge, and a centered CTA button below the grid.

items.name: feature-card-illustrated
items.title: Feature Card Illustrated
items.description: A self-contained feature card with a live mini-illustration (list, code editor, bar chart, chart node, or dashboard node) animating in the background, a title/description, and a solid or outline CTA button.

items.name: video-glow-lightbox
items.title: Video Glow Lightbox
items.description: A single video card with a pulsing glow-blob frame that morphs into a fullscreen lightbox on click — supports direct URL, YouTube, Vimeo, or uploaded files, a cursor-following watch label, hover preview loop, and a Web Audio sound-reactive glow.

items.name: testimonial-logos
items.title: Testimonial Logos
items.description: A compact trust bar — a star rating with a helped-N-teams label above an infinite, edge-masked logo marquee.

items.name: motion-gallery-grid
items.title: Motion Gallery Grid
items.description: A perfectly aligned image grid with a centered glassmorphism overlay card — heading, subtitle and CTA button, with a staggered blur/slide/fade/scale entrance triggered on scroll into view.

items.name: qr-code-widget
items.title: QR Code Widget
items.description: A QR-code card — title, description, code image, hint text and an open-link button, inline or as a corner-widget popup with a focus-trapped modal dialog.

items.name: airbnb-reviews
items.title: Airbnb Reviews
items.description: A guest-review carousel with the Airbnb Bélo mark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

items.name: ebay-reviews
items.title: eBay Reviews
items.description: A seller-feedback carousel with the eBay wordmark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

items.name: etsy-reviews
items.title: Etsy Reviews
items.description: A shop-review carousel with the Etsy wordmark, aggregate rating header and CTA, above a draggable autoplaying grid of review cards.

items.name: coin-flip-game
items.title: Coin Flip Game
items.description: A real 3D CSS coin — click or tap to flip with a physical spin animation, a yes/no question field, flip history dots, and a heads/tails ratio readout.

items.name: tic-tac-toe-game
items.title: Tic Tac Toe Game
items.description: A playable Tic Tac Toe board with a built-in AI opponent, animated piece placement, a drawn winning-line reveal, score tracking, and a confetti burst on a win.

items.name: 2048-game
items.title: 2048 Game
items.description: A fully playable 2048 — arrow-key and swipe controls, spring-animated tile merges, score and best-score tracking, and win/game-over overlays.

items.name: snake-game
items.title: Snake Game
items.description: A canvas-rendered Snake game with three difficulty speeds, keyboard and swipe controls, a directional-eyes snake head, high-score tracking, and ready/game-over overlays.

items.name: minesweeper-game
items.title: Minesweeper Game
items.description: A classic Minesweeper with three board sizes, flood-fill reveal, right-click flagging, a live mine counter and timer, and a confetti burst on a win.

items.name: memory-match-game
items.title: Memory Match Game
items.description: A flip-card memory matching game with animal emoji, three difficulty levels, a 3D flip animation, move/score tracking, and a win overlay.

items.name: pong-game
items.title: Pong Game
items.description: A canvas Pong against a bot opponent — three difficulty levels, multi-round progression with a color shift and speed increase each round, keyboard and touch-drag paddle control.

items.name: dino-runner-game
items.title: Dino Runner Game
items.description: A canvas endless-runner in the style of the offline dino game — pixel-drawn running dino, procedurally spawned cactus obstacles, three difficulty speeds, tap/space/arrow-up to jump, and a high-score tracker.

items.name: space-invaders-game
items.title: Space Invaders Game
items.description: A canvas Space Invaders — a descending grid of pixel-drawn invaders that shoot back, three difficulty levels, keyboard controls on desktop and on-screen move/fire buttons on mobile, with a win/lose end screen.

items.name: tower-blocks-game
items.title: Tower Blocks Game
items.description: A dependency-free stack-the-block game rendered on a single canvas with a hand-rolled isometric projection — perfect stacks keep the tower's width, misaligned drops chop the overhang off and it falls away.

items.name: maze-runner-game
items.title: Maze Runner Game
items.description: A procedurally generated recursive-backtracker maze across 10 difficulty levels, with keyboard, swipe, mouse-wheel, device-tilt, and gamepad controls, a live timer, and a speed-based score.

items.name: glow-jump-widget

items.description: A floating-action-button popup that opens a glowing 4-level platformer — jump between walls, dodge moving lava, and collect coins to finish each level, keyboard and on-screen touch controls included.

items.name: balloon-popper-game
items.title: Balloon Popper Game
items.description: A mouse-aimed bow-and-arrow balloon-popping mini-game — pop enough balloons within your arrow limit to unlock a coupon code, with a fail/retry screen if you run out.

items.name: dart-throw-game
items.title: Dart Throw Game
items.description: A drag-to-aim, release-to-throw target game with gravity-arced projectiles, ring-based scoring, streak bonuses, a best-score tracker, and a confetti burst on bullseyes.

items.name: spin-to-win-wheel
items.title: Spin to Win Wheel
items.description: A canvas-drawn prize wheel with a single-spin-per-visitor lock (persisted in localStorage), eased spin-down physics, and a reward modal with a copyable coupon code.

items.name: memory-cards-widget
items.title: Memory Cards Widget
items.description: A floating-action-button popup that opens a color-matching memory game — 3 difficulty levels, a live timer/move counter, best-score tracking, subtle Web Audio sound effects, and a confetti win screen.

items.name: bubble-cursor
items.title: Bubble Cursor

items.name: glass-showcase-scroll
items.title: Glass Showcase Scroll
items.description: A scroll-driven 3D glass box (Three.js) that rotates through a set of images with particle-explosion transitions between them, plus an optional gentle float animation.

items.name: wave-marquee

items.description: An SVG textPath marquee that tiles text along a curved track — wave, circle, infinity, arch, or line — with an optional gradient glowing ribbon and a second independent layer for a layered scrolling effect.

items.name: progress-rows-card
items.title: Progress Rows Card
items.description: A light/dark card of labeled gradient progress bars with dividers between rows, animating to their target width on scroll-into-view or immediately.

items.name: feature-media-highlight

items.description: A two-column feature section — a heading and rich-text subtitles with inline bold-highlight markup on one side, a configurable image/video panel on the other, stacking on narrow widths with scroll fade-ins.

items.name: cinematic-stacked-gallery

items.name: phone-reel-showcase
items.title: Phone Reel Showcase
items.description: An iPhone mockup that plays a swipeable, story-style reel of videos and images with tap/drag navigation, a progress bar, 3D cursor tilt, and an ambient glow behind the device.

items.name: cinematic-scroll-story

items.name: dice-roll-discount-popup
items.title: Dice Roll Discount Popup
items.description: A gamified discount-capture widget where visitors roll two 3D dice for a reward tier, with a themed reveal modal and code copy, rendered inline or as a corner-launched popup with manual/delay/scroll triggers.

items.name: wheel-spin-discount-popup
items.title: Wheel Spin Discount Popup
items.description: A gamified discount-capture widget where visitors spin a weighted SVG prize wheel for a reward, with a themed reveal modal and code copy, rendered inline or as a corner-launched popup with manual/delay/scroll triggers.
